title: Tracing Provenance and Detecting Tampering with Complementary LLM Watermarks
abstract: arXiv:2608.12713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Watermarking LLM-generated text is an important task for tracing its provenance. Existing LLM watermarks preserve provenance under editing, but this same robustness allows an adversary to alter critical content while retaining attribution, a vulnerability known as piggyback spoofing. We introduce an innovative watermark that jointly provides provenance and tamper evidence. It co-embeds a robust signal and a fragile signal into each generated token. The signals share the same mechanism but use independent keys and different seeding windows over normalized text, making one resilient to edits and the other sensitive to reader-visible changes. Multiple rounds of unbiased tournament reweighting preserve the expected generation distribution, while a periodic round-allocation pattern controls the trade-off between the two signals. At detection, their scores form a two-dimensional space supporting three decisions: Intact, Tampered, and No-Wate

translated_title: 追踪来源与检测篡改：互补式LLM水印技术
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12713v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对LLM生成的文本进行水印处理是追踪其来源的重要任务。现有的LLM水印在编辑下保持来源追踪能力，但这一鲁棒性也允许攻击者篡改关键内容而保留归属，即所谓的“搭便车欺骗”漏洞。我们提出了一种创新水印，它同时提供来源追踪和篡改证据。该水印在每个生成令牌中共同嵌入一个鲁棒信号和一个脆弱信号。这两个信号共享相同机制，但使用独立密钥和不同的标准化文本种子窗口，使一个对编辑具有抵抗力，另一个对读者可见的变化敏感。通过多轮无偏锦标赛重加权保持预期生成分布，而周期性轮次分配模式控制两个信号之间的权衡。在检测时，它们的分数形成一个二维空间，支持三种决策：完整、篡改和无水印。
tldr: 本文提出一种联合水印方法，通过在同一生成令牌中嵌入鲁棒和脆弱信号，实现来源追踪与篡改检测的双重功能，有效应对搭便车欺骗攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a joint watermarking method that embeds robust and fragile signals in each generated token to achieve both provenance tracing and tamper detection, effectively countering piggyback spoofing attacks.
